main.description: Store a file in a context: the raw bytes as the body, their type as `Content-Type`. A member of the context may. The file is then at `GET /blob/<id>`, for whoever may read the context. A node refers to it by `id`; the same bytes uploaded twice are stored once and get two ids.

context.description: The context the file belongs to, which decides who may read it.

name.description: The file's name, offered back when it is downloaded.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such context, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a member of the context.

errors.name: BlobTooLarge
errors.description: The file is larger than this AppView accepts (HTTP 413).

errors.name: StorageFull
errors.description: The caller, or the context, has stored as much as is allowed (HTTP 413). Deleting files gives the room back.
